verdict.rationale: Adyen's documentation-tools page describes an agent-oriented docs surface: llms.txt at docs.adyen.com/llms.txt, raw markdown for most pages by appending `.md`, and a full docs mirror ZIP for giving context to AI agents. Live probes independently confirmed that both llms.txt and the `.md` page rendering return HTTP 200.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Most pages on our documentation site can be rendered as a raw markdown file by simply appending `.md` to the URL
Give context to AI agents: Provide the full documentation set to code assistants, chatbots, or other AI tools. This works well in restricted or air gapped environments.
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.adyen.com/llms.txt # Adyen Docs
Provide context to LLMs: The specification files can be used as valuable context to code assistants when working with Adyen APIs, especially when paired with Adyen MCP.
